reviewType: AI author self-audit of unpublished provisional drafts

checks.name: Source occurrence invariant
checks.evidence: All eight expressions, guide-written source sentences, rendered PDF pages and book numbers exactly match the source inventory rows.

checks.name: Full-source target detector
checks.evidence: Each target regex matches its complete source sentence and the intended model uses.

checks.name: SOP seven-step architecture
checks.evidence: Each lesson has listening, four-valid reply, changed scene, sense-boundary contrast, dialogue, speaking, and a new-context writing task with two English-Chinese models.

checks.name: Four valid replies and answer defensibility
checks.evidence: All four reply choices are responses to a shared grounded prompt; only the golden option uses the target expression. Scene, contrast and dialogue each have one keyed answer. An independent editorial pass remains required.

checks.name: English-Chinese fidelity
checks.evidence: Manually compared lesson passages, answer options, models and explanations for polarity, modality, subject, timing and affected party. Independent bilingual review remains required.

checks.name: Glossary spans and target exclusion
checks.evidence: Every glossary phrase is an exact indexed span of one suggested answer and excludes the target expression; both writing models use the target in a changed context.

checks.name: Speaking target span
checks.evidence: Builder verified every speaking highlight span against its model and target pattern.

checks.name: Focused build and check
checks.evidence: Both batch files separately built four lessons, 24 questions, 16 audio requests, and zero review flags; both --check runs passed.

checks.name: Review and release status
checks.evidence: All review lanes remain pending; no selection manifest, live lesson or release file was changed.
